answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to harbor staked capital to gain network influence. Rather than relying on identity, it creates an oasis of economic security where each validation slot requires a proportional financial commitment. For an attacker, attempting to forge an opal of multiple identities becomes prohibitively expensive, as increasing one's voting weight necessitates locking up massive amounts of collateral, effectively making collusion a net-negative strategy.
